Outcome: when a session is assigned a cohesive batch, the leader registers it and owns one integration branch and worktree; member subagents implement in their own worktrees started from the integration head, merge in the current head, and run scoped checks and the local oracle review; the leader lands each member with batch-land and prepares it in the tracker; one final PR goes to develop through pr-open and pr-arm, with the tracker binding following review fixes; members are finished after the merge.

Order: todo-db contract, todo-db semantics, todo-db release, BenchBox runtime; worktree BASE and member review in parallel; member then leader tooling and final-PR checks; docs and skills; end-to-end proof; pilot; default flip. The mapper fix and member-branch cleanup run separately.
